title: When Louis Vuitton Beat Molly Tea in Court — and Lost the Chinese Internet
primaryKeyword: Louis Vuitton Molly Tea trademark China
audience: Readers who saw the viral Short and want court facts, cultural context, and measurable market signals — not meme law.
metaDescription: Suzhou court awarded Louis Vuitton ¥10.3M against Molly Tea. The law was routine; the backlash was not. Filings, similar cases, and what the Shorts missed.
angle: Separate the first-instance trademark judgment from the cultural-heritage frame and the secondary-market noise. One claim per chart.
